strings.settings.notifications_bg_help: Reminders fire via Android's alarm system. Grant these once and BTT can deliver them in the background — no persistent notification, no battery hit between alarms.
strings.settings.notifications_close_note: Reminders pause if you Force Stop the app in Android Settings. Normal "close" or swipe-away is fine — they keep running. Open BTT now and then (or tap Refresh) to extend the schedule.

strings.settings.notifications_permission_denied: Notification permission was denied. Enable it in Android Settings to receive reminders.
strings.settings.notifications_row_lead_desc: Fire this many minutes before the rotation starts. Minimum 5.
